thread:
maria-finance: Quick question from the EDU pilot — can your billing produce a consolidated monthly invoice that covers multiple institutions under a single master PO, and also line-itemize charges by SKU (embeddings vs. generation) so we can map to internal cost centers? cc @ajay-procurement @ben-eng

jennifer_eduvendor: Yep, we can do consolidated invoices + line items. Two clarifying q's: 1) do you need per-institution billing codes on each line? 2) Do you need a per-org usage CSV for chargebacks? :slightly_smiling_face:
ajay-procurement: We need the CSV export for chargebacks. Also edu/nonprofit discounted tiers are required. PO terms should be net30. We will need your W9/TIN for the PO flow.

ben-eng: Example CSV columns we'll need for internal tooling:```date, org_id, org_name, project_code, sku, usage_units, unit_price, discount, line_total, invoice_id```Mapping to our chargeback service should be straightforward if those exist.

maria-finance: Thanks — one more ask: pilot credit (one-off) of 50,000 embedding units should be applied before tiered discounts. Can your billing apply that as a negative line item on the first invoice? Also please include PO number and our project code in the invoice memo.

sara-legal: From legal side — we'll require a standard DPA and an export-control clause for non-US institutions. Also confirm that no model weights or training data are transferred to customers. Please provide a sample SOW if you have one.

jennifer_eduvendor: I can confirm the credit as a negative line on invoice 1 and include PO/project code. We provide the CSV with these exact columns. Trial credits typically expire after 90 days unless otherwise negotiated. For discounts — we do tiered unit pricing by default but can convert to a negative "credit" line if that’s easier for your accounting. Will loop in our billing ops (@procure-bot) and sales-ops to send samples.

ajay-procurement: Action items: vendor to share a sample invoice PDF + sample CSV layout by EOD Thu; vendor to confirm nonprofit discount percentages for these brackets: 0-500k units, 500k-2M, >2M; confirm whether discounts are applied before or after pilot credit; provide W9/TIN for PO; any reseller paperwork? Finance will draft PO template.

procure-bot: Acked — adding billing_ops@eduvendor to the thread. Reminder: PO creation lead time usually 7–10 business days once vendor paperwork is in.

ben-eng: One engineering note — embeddings are metered per-vector (1 vector = 1 unit) not per token. If you can provide an estimated cost table given our projected monthly vectors (we'll share numbers in a follow-up), that'd help sizing.

jennifer_eduvendor: Understood — I'll send sample invoice + CSV + an estimated cost table for your projected vector bands tonight. Also I'll flag the export-control and DPA asks to our legal contact and share a draft SOW by EOD Fri.

maria-finance: Perfect — thanks. If vendor can confirm the discount % and attach the invoice samples we can start PO paperwork next week. :thumbsup:
